rows.reason: foundation:color — measured token contrast has passing body/accent pairs but failing UI border pairs.
rows.remediation: Raise --line or use a higher-contrast border role in dark and light themes, then rerun rendered contrast for every interactive state.

evidence.summary: Measured OKLCH token pairs across dark, light, and prefers-contrast modes.

rows.reason: foundation:typography — the source defines a coherent scale and measures, but live font readiness and no-overflow reflow are not proven.
rows.remediation: Capture font readiness and narrow/400% reflow in a live browser; move the release-facts text inside the document and remove the overflow mask that hides the defect.

evidence.summary: Measured local font declarations, clamp sizes, unitless leading, and committed-capture overflow evidence.

measurements.overflow_observation: release-facts text is outside <html> at source lines 2-4 and is visibly clipped in 390px and 768px captures; body overflow-x:hidden at line 123 masks horizontal overflow.

rows.reason: foundation:spacing — no --space-* ladder is declared, and the many literal gaps cannot be tied to one verified scale.
rows.remediation: Declare one semantic spacing ladder, map intentional exceptions in a decision record, and rerun proximity checks on the rendered path.

evidence.summary: Measured spacing literals and clamp ranges from the inline stylesheet.

rows.reason: foundation:theming — semantic role blocks exist for dark, light, and prefers-contrast, but per-theme live state measurements are absent.
rows.remediation: Run the theme buttons in a live browser, record rendered pairs and native-control color-scheme behavior, and attach a cold-load/no-flash observation.

evidence.summary: Measured authored theme mappings; runtime theme-state proof was not available after the local Chrome launch aborted.

rows.reason: structure:responsive-layout — the three committed required-view captures render, but 390px/768px show clipped pre-document release text and all captures retain low-opacity scroll-reveal content.
rows.remediation: Move release facts inside <body>, make initial content visible on cold load or capture after the reveal contract completes, and rerun 390/768/1280 plus 320/400% checks.

evidence.summary: Measured committed PNG dimensions, viewport-dependent grid rules, crop observations, and reveal state.

responsive_rules: hero grid auto 1fr with gap clamp(1rem, 1rem + 1.5vw, 2.2rem)
bento grid 6 columns; max-width 900px -> 4 columns; max-width 560px -> 2 columns

rows.reason: structure:component-states — default/loading/disabled states are represented on a native button, with focus-visible CSS and measurable timing.
rows.remediation: Keep the native button semantics and rerun the state cycle in a live browser after the release-facts/reveal repairs.

evidence.summary: Measured three-state component cycle and retained NIMA receipt.

rows.reason: structure:form-ux — the email field is labeled and autofill-ready and blur repair is demonstrated, but no submit path exists.
rows.remediation: Add a real submit handler with truthful success/failure ownership, preserve the value on failure, focus the first error, and rerun the field matrix.

evidence.summary: Measured empty/invalid/valid field states from the markup and blur/input handlers.

rows.reason: structure:empty-states — loading, empty, error, and retry are explicit status states with a stable region and recovery control.
rows.remediation: Keep the status/live-region wiring and verify layout stability in a live browser after scroll-reveal initialization is repaired.

evidence.summary: Measured four empty-state controls and status-region wiring.

rows.reason: verification:a11y — native controls, labels, skip link, focus-visible styling, and measured text contrast are present, but invalid pre-document text and clipped captures remain unresolved.
rows.remediation: Move release facts into valid document structure, remove the hidden-overflow mask, and rerun a live keyboard/assistive-technology audit.

evidence.summary: Measured static audit surface plus markup/capture defects.

rows.reason: gate:artifact-spec — index.html and the measured two-asset dependency closure hash correctly, but the design-system spec is not bound into the artifact manifest.
rows.remediation: Add site/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md to a declared dependency manifest or record an approved spec identity binding, then rerun the release gate.

evidence.summary: Measured artifact identity, bytes, dependency manifest, and design-system spec identity.

measurements.closure_note: inline CSS references five local fonts and site/img/basalt-copper.png, but the measured closure is favicon.ico + index.html

rows.reason: gate:required-evidence — numeric and browser evidence are present in the ledger, but six required browser legs and all subjective independent-review rows are intentionally absent.
rows.remediation: Complete the absent browser legs with fresh receipts, obtain independent human reviews for subjective checks, then rerun the gate against the same artifact and frozen inventory.

evidence.summary: Measured ledger coverage against the closed 27-check catalog.

measurements.absent_reason: subjective checks require independent human review; browser legs require live browser receipts not derivable from committed default captures
